history.author: ida
history.body: Chit the seed potatoes in February. Earth up when shoots show.

history.author: jon
history.body: The shed by the gate leaks; the felt roof needs replacing.

history.author: ida
history.body: The shed was taken down in May. Wheelbarrow lives in the [[Compost]] corner now.

history.author: jon
history.body: Two bays. Turn monthly. Greens and browns half and half.

comments.author: jon
comments.text: Maris Piper did best last year.

comments.author: ida
comments.text: I can bring roofing felt on Saturday.

comments.author: ida
comments.text: Please no cooked food in the bays.
